_note: Example config of the $UNITS fee keeper (packages/fee-keeper, docs/MAINNET-RUNBOOK.md "UNITS fee keeper"). Public values only: no key, and the RPC URL comes from UNITS_FEE_KEEPER_RPC. Owner decision 2026-10-12: 50% of the $UNITS coin's creator fees funds compute, 50% buys $UNITS and burns it. creator, key_path and compute_address have no default: the owner sets them. The lamport limits below are examples to be set by the owner, not recommendations; every field can be changed at any time by editing the file (the next run reads it).
_protected_units_note: Base units of $UNITS (6 decimals) in the creator wallet's own token account that are the owner's and that the keeper must never touch. Required, no default. "0" here means the wallet holds none of its own: set it to the wallet's real holdings before enabling, and change it whenever those holdings change. The keeper signs nothing while the wallet's own account holds less.
